import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load data and filter
df = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
df = df.dropna(subset=['QED_delta', 'MW_delta'])
df = df[df['MW_delta'] != 0].copy()
df['efficiency'] = df['QED_delta'] / df['MW_delta']

# 2. Split groups
grp103 = df.loc[df['task_id'] == 103, 'efficiency']
grp_other = df.loc[df['task_id'] != 103, 'efficiency']

# 3. Summary statistics
def summarize(series):
    return {
        'n': int(series.count()),
        'mean': series.mean(),
        'median': series.median(),
        'variance': series.var()
    }
sum103 = summarize(grp103)
sum_other = summarize(grp_other)

print("Efficiency summary (QED_delta/MW_delta):")
print("Group      n       mean      median    variance")
print(f"task 103  {sum103['n']:7d}  {sum103['mean']:8.6f}  {sum103['median']:8.6f}  {sum103['variance']:10.6f}")
print(f"others    {sum_other['n']:7d}  {sum_other['mean']:8.6f}  {sum_other['median']:8.6f}  {sum_other['variance']:10.6f}\n")

# 4. Levene's test for equal variances
levene_stat, levene_p = stats.levene(grp103, grp_other)
print(f"Levene's test: stat={levene_stat:.4f}, p-value={levene_p:.4e}")

# 5. Mann-Whitney U test
mw_stat, mw_p = stats.mannwhitneyu(grp103, grp_other, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Mann-Whitney U test: U={mw_stat:.2f}, p-value={mw_p:.4e}\n")

# 6. Visualization
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
df_plot = pd.DataFrame({
    'efficiency': np.concatenate([grp103.values, grp_other.values]),
    'group': ['task 103'] * len(grp103) + ['others'] * len(grp_other)
})
sns.boxplot(x='group', y='efficiency', data=df_plot, showfliers=False)
# annotate means
means = df_plot.groupby('group')['efficiency'].mean()
for i, (grp, m) in enumerate(means.items()):
    plt.text(i, m, f"{m:.4f}", color='red', ha='center', va='bottom')
plt.title('Efficiency (QED_delta/MW_delta) for task 103 vs others')
plt.ylabel('Efficiency (QED_delta per MW unit)')
plt.xlabel('Group')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
